title: Harbor Pulse 1.1: Full Shift

objective.summary: Separate successful full-shift survival from reputation-collapse failure so only legitimate clears submit scores or count as completion.

changes: Harbor Pulse emits neutral shift-complete plus explicit shift-cleared/shift-failed terminal telemetry
Only shift-cleared is a platform milestone/true completion and only successful clears carry a numeric score
Failed shifts no longer update wwg:harbor-best
Harbor Pulse metadata/objective/control guidance advanced to 1.1 with explicit score metadata
v72 cache/query metadata and Harbor Pulse install shortcut
